title: 2.5 Boss: Range Vault Heist
concept: BST range query and kth smallest
objective: Click all 5 keys inside Range [25..75], then click the 4th-smallest key to breach Wing 3!
controls: Click all keys in [25..75] -> Click 4th-smallest node
start_status: Stage 1/2: Click all 5 BST keys in Range [25..75].
hints: Check every node against both bounds - in-range keys appear on both sides of the root.
The kth smallest is the kth node in Inorder order. Count up from the smallest key.
